correctness.rationale: Expanding the Nijenhuis identity on image×image, kernel×kernel and mixed pairs shows equivalence to complementary Lie subalgebras. All 2-dimensional sl2 subalgebras in char!=2 are Borels: their nonzero derived element has trace-square zero and is nilpotent, giving a unique rational invariant line. Each Borel plane has exactly q² complementary projective lines, so ranks 1 and 2 both count q²(q+1). In Borel coordinates F+aH+bE, projective upper triangular conjugation sends a′=ta+u and b′=t²b−2tau−u², so discriminant a²+b scales by t² and yields three orbits with stated sizes. Independent symbolic conjugation and finite-field class sums at q=3,5,7 corroborate algebraic proof; no reliance on stored VERIFY_OK.
